title: Galaxy spin handedness: a mirror test before the result

sentences.text: Galaxy spin handedness: a mirror test before the result.
sentences.visual_action: Title resolves over two unlabeled explanation paths and one central spiral.

sentences.text: Can an apparent imbalance between clockwise and anticlockwise labels be separated from one introduced by the labeling process?
sentences.visual_action: The opening question spans two equal, unresolved explanation lanes.

sentences.text: Two explanations can create the same apparent imbalance.
sentences.visual_action: Two explanation nodes feed the same unresolved count symbol.

sentences.text: One places the pattern in the images.
sentences.visual_action: The IMAGE-LINKED lane illuminates around a spiral image.

sentences.text: The other places it in the labeling process.
sentences.visual_action: The LABELING-PROCESS lane illuminates around a human-labeling node.

sentences.text: Apply one test to both: mirror a conceptual spiral horizontally.
sentences.visual_action: One conceptual spiral moves to a vertical mirror plane and begins a continuous horizontal flip.

sentences.text: The geometry reverses, and its apparent label inverts from clockwise to anticlockwise.
sentences.visual_action: The same spiral completes its horizontal inversion while the label morphs from clockwise to anticlockwise.

sentences.text: An image-linked pattern must follow that inversion.
sentences.visual_action: The image-linked prediction arrow follows the inverted geometry and pulses MUST INVERT.

sentences.text: A labeling-process effect need not follow the pixels.
sentences.visual_action: The labeling-process prediction separates from the pixel transform and pulses NEED NOT INVERT.

sentences.text: One mirror, two predicted behaviors: that is the discriminant.
sentences.visual_action: The two prediction lanes lock into one MIRROR DISCRIMINANT diagram, the visual peak.

sentences.text: Before any number was computed, we fixed the mirror logic, every cut, both thresholds, and paired comparisons.
sentences.visual_action: A pre-registration bracket closes around MIRROR, CUTS, THRESHOLDS, and PAIRED COMPARISON.

sentences.text: The frozen Galaxy Zoo 1 source contains 667,944 rows.
sentences.visual_action: Row particles stream into a Galaxy Zoo 1 data release, Table 2 reservoir with the sample size attached.

sentences.text: Three parallel readouts apply the spiral flag and two frozen thresholds; exact counts stay attached to their branches.
sentences.visual_action: The source splits into three parallel branches; each labeled stage reveals its exact row count.

sentences.text: Within one readout, N C W and N A C W count the labels.
sentences.visual_action: N_CW and N_ACW chips detach from one branch and enter a formula workspace.

sentences.text: Their difference is the numerator, and their total is the denominator.
sentences.visual_action: The numerator and denominator build term by term around a fraction bar.

sentences.text: The sign would indicate which label is more numerous, but the predeclared asymmetry value remains withheld.
sentences.visual_action: A symmetric unselected sign rail appears; the symbolic equation completes and a value lock closes in the same state.

sentences.text: The control matrix joins the mirror, both thresholds, and same-object pairs.
sentences.visual_action: Three control rows reveal: mirror, thresholds, paired same object.

sentences.text: They test inversion, threshold sensitivity, and individual change versus sample composition; design only.
sentences.visual_action: Each control connects to its tested failure mode; DESIGN ONLY banner wipes across.

sentences.text: We tied our own hands so the answer cannot be shaped by choices made after seeing it.
sentences.visual_action: A discipline seal closes around the full method while later-choice arrows are visibly blocked.

sentences.text: That standard makes the independent post-run verdict the next gate; the stored-direction frame and evidence, receipt, and referee checks must also meet the frozen rules.
sentences.visual_action: Specific open review nodes appear as consequences of the self-imposed standard; a pulse stops before the answer field.

sentences.text: Known now are the sample, estimator, mirror logic, and controls; no result value, direction, or interpretation is reportable.
sentences.visual_action: KNOWN and NOT REPORTABLE boundary columns build from the discipline diagram.

sentences.text: Ask the opening question again: images or labeling process?
sentences.visual_action: The exact two-explanation question returns above the completed mirror discriminant.

sentences.text: Now we have a mirror test that forces those explanations to behave differently.
sentences.visual_action: The mirror diagram reconnects both explanation lanes to a gated, still-empty answer field.

sentences.text: Its gate-cleared answer is still missing; the scientific discriminant is not.
sentences.visual_action: The final frame holds the scientific discriminant and the two explanations, not a workflow slogan.
